DLC2323:3:t_3:31.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「Exactly! Better to work an honest job than end up like little $$クロウ$$!」

DLC2323:3:t_3:33.en:
$n
「What's the problem? Everything worked out in the end.」

DLC2323:3:t_3:34.en:
$$セツコ$$
「So your life in debt can be useful sometimes, $$クロウ$$.」

DLC2323:3:t_3:35.en:
$$ランド$$
「Nice job showing us what not to do, $$クロウ$$!」

DLC2323:3:t_3:37.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's what they call drawing the short straw... In other words, it's your usual role.」

DLC2323:3:t_3:39.en:
$$スズネ$$
（I don't understand that reaction at all...）

DLC2323:3:t_3:40.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Whatever. Now I can move on to the next battle with a clear conscience.」

DLC2323:3:t_3:41.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's right. We'll leave for Earth as soon as we're ready.」

DLC2323:3:t_3:42.en:
$$クロウ$$
「There's somewhere I'd like us to stop first.」

DLC2323:3:t_3:43.en:
$$トライア$$
「I know. It wouldn't have much atmosphere with a battle going on.」

DLC2323:3:t_4:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...And so the infamous mercenary band $$ファイヤバグ$$ quietly met its end amid the fighting.」

DLC2323:3:t_4:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Perhaps its only remaining trace is the $$ＡＣＰファイズ$$ that $$クロウ$$ uses.」

DLC2323:3:t_4:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And someday... when he stops fighting, $$ファイヤバグ$$ will disappear entirely. Though I cannot say when that will be...」

DLC2323:3:t_4:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And with that, everyone... Until we meet again.」

DLC2323:4:t_001:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We haven't seen them since their employer, $$アマルガム$$, was defeated...」

DLC2323:4:t_001:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Never thought they'd be here on $$火星$$.」

DLC2323:4:t_001:3.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「Grr... To run into $$クロウ・ブルースト$$ here...!」

DLC2323:4:t_001:5.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「Then there's only one thing to do! M-U-R-D-E-R! Right now!」

DLC2323:4:t_001:8.en:
$$クロウ$$
「As far as they're concerned, this is where $$マリリン$$ went down. Probably a grudge.」

DLC2323:4:t_001:9.en:
$$ランド$$
「So we've got no choice but to fight...!」

DLC2323:4:t_001:10.en:
$n
「The settlers' base is behind us too! We can't let them through!」

DLC2323:4:t_001:11.en:
$$トライア$$
「The $$Ｚクリスタル$$'s undergoing maintenance right now. Event control's barely usable, so be careful out there.」

DLC2323:4:t_001:12.en:
$$クロウ$$
「After all these years, we meet again...」

DLC2323:4:t_001:13.en:
$$クロウ$$
「This is a good opportunity, $$ファイヤバグ$$! I'll finish you off here, where we made those memories!」

DLC2323:4:t_002:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「Incoming fire! All units, evade!」

DLC2323:4:t_004:0.en:
$$メール$$
「$$ファイヤバグ$$'s running away!」

DLC2323:4:t_004:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Then this attack... isn't from their reinforcements!?」

DLC2323:4:t_005:3.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「Correct, Earthling. We will occupy it and make this planet ours.」

DLC2323:4:t_005:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
「The $$新地球皇国$$ has already fallen! Surrender peacefully or leave the solar system!」

DLC2323:4:t_005:6.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「Silence! Once reinforcements arrive from the galactic center, we can take Earth again in no time!」

DLC2323:4:t_005:7.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「We will conquer this planet to serve as our bridgehead!」

DLC2323:4:t_005:8.en:
$$スズネ$$
「How can you still be saying things like that...!?」

DLC2323:4:t_005:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Let me ask you, $$サイデリアル$$. You have no intention of agreeing to a cease-fire?」

DLC2323:4:t_005:10.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「Not unless you surrender.」

DLC2323:4:t_005:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「One last time. We advised you to surrender, and you refuse... Is that right?」

DLC2323:4:t_007:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Then you get no mercy! Brace yourselves!」

DLC2323:4:t_007:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「If you insist on fighting, then we'll take you on!」

DLC2323:4:t_007:4.en:
$n
「Of course I feel the same way! If they want a fight, I'll give them one!」

DLC2323:4:t_007:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Damn right! Let's hit these war-addled idiots who don't understand the value of peace hard!」

DLC2323:4:t_008:0.en:
$$トビー$$
「Tch! They had an ambush force ready!」

DLC2323:4:t_008:1.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「This is bad! They're going to break through!」

DLC2323:4:t_009:0.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「The $$アークセイバー$$s have come!?」

DLC2323:4:t_010:3.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「We will simply carry out our final mission.」

DLC2323:4:t_010:5.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「When the $$姫$$ fired us, she told us this...」

DLC2323:4:t_010:6.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「Whatever happens to me from now on, protect $$インサラウム$$...」

DLC2323:4:t_010:7.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「$$マリリン・キャット$$ said that...?」

DLC2323:4:t_010:8.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「$$サイデリアル$$! If you lay a hand on the people of $$インサラウム$$, you will answer to us!」

DLC2323:4:t_010:9.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「We will carry out our final mission! With our feelings for the $$姫$$ in our hearts!」

DLC2323:4:t_010:10.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「$$姫$$! $$姫$$! P-R-I-N-C-E-S-S! We dedicate this battle to our $$姫$$ in heaven!」

DLC2323:4:t_010:11.en:
$$トライア$$
「What will you do, $$クロウ$$?」

DLC2323:4:t_010:12.en:
$$クロウ$$
「There's nothing to decide. If they're not our enemies, we can leave them alone.」

DLC2323:4:t_010:13.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「You acknowledge our battle... You have our thanks, $$クロウ・ブルースト$$.」

DLC2323:4:t_010:14.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「As a reward, you may rejoin $$ファイヤバグ$$, debt-ridden little $$クロウ$$.」

review.context: Framing scenes show Firebug disbanding; the battle flashback reveals its last mission to protect Insaraum from Sidereal, fulfilling Marilyn final order.
decisions: The Princess refers to Marilyn, with the original group chant translated into spelled-out English.
Crowe explicitly confirms the enemy refuses surrender before engaging.
ACP Faiz is a provisional romanization of an unlisted weapon name.
uncertainties: ACP Faiz requires glossary confirmation; orchestrator notified.
